g.text: PVC SUSPENSION REACTOR VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
PFD-100 PVC suspension polymerisation — R-101 area
PVC SUSPENSION POLYMERISATION — R-101 AREA (1 OF 4 REACTORS)
1. Flags: R-101 design state 2.0 h into the reaction (OTS model); charge rates are the FIC set points.
2. Batch: 60 t water + PVA, 51 t VCM, initiator; 57 °C, 8.6 bar g; end point at 1.8 bar pressure drop.
3. Recovered VCM is condensed before storage (condenser not shown). Baffle CW and N2 pad not shown.
4. T-201, S-201, D-201 are shared by R-101 to R-104 and shown as blocks only.
